scenario_description:
Objective: Add optional professional cacao-emulsion critique to a learner-owned tasting comparison for portfolio polish.
Emerging Need: A possible guest table is unusable while scope and access are unsettled; it becomes worthwhile only after an open study window, verified enrichment channel, seat code, and submission terms align.
Decision Context: Saved records identify a ready cacao tasting-note title and limits on what may be shared, while live notices supply timing, channel, no-fee status, and cutoff.
Consequence: A timely seat could sharpen sensory language and technique choices; missing the export leaves coursework, spending, requirements, and ordinary portfolio progress unchanged.
